blocks.text: Bilvosita savol: Do you know where ...?

To'g'ri savol: **Where does Tom live?** Uni boshqa gap ichiga — Do you know ...? I don't know ... Can you tell me ...? — joylashtirsak, u **bilvosita savol** bo'ladi va so'z tartibi **darak gapdagidek** qaytadi: Do you know where **Tom lives**? Yordamchi fe'l (does) yo'qoladi, ega fe'ldan oldinga chiqadi, fe'l esa o'z shaklini oladi (lives). O'zbekchada ham shunga o'xshash o'zgarish bor: «Tom qayerda yashaydi?» → «Tom qayerda **yashashini** bilasizmi?» — savol ot kabi shaklga (`-ish`, `-ini`) o'tadi.

Nega tartib qaytadi? Endi asosiy savol — **Do you know ...?** Inversiya (yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin) faqat asosiy savolda bo'ladi; ichki qism esa oddiy ma'lumot, darak gap kabi. Bir gapda faqat bitta inversiya bo'ladi. Shuning uchun asosiy gap darak bo'lsa (I don't know ...), oxirida so'roq belgisi ham qo'yilmaydi: I don't know where she lives**.**

rows: Do you know where **the station is**?
Can you tell me what time **it is**?
I don't know who **that man is**.
I'm not sure when **they will** arrive.
Could you tell me how **I can** get there?
U yerga qanday borishimni ayta olasizmi?

items.text: Do you know where **the bank is**?
I don't know what **her name is**.
Can you tell me how far **the airport is**?

blocks.text: Present Simple va Past Simple savollaridagi **do / does / did** bilvosita savolda butunlay tushib qoladi, uning «ishi» — zamon va shaxs belgisi — fe'lga qaytadi: What **does** he **want**? → I don't know what he **wants**. When **did** the film **start**? → Do you know when the film **started**? Where **did** she **go**? → I don't know where she **went**.

rows: Could you tell me how much it **costs**?
I can't remember what time the bus **came**.

items.text: Do you know what time **the shop opens**?
I can't remember where **I parked** the car.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning eng ko'p xatolari — bilvosita savolda ham savol tartibini saqlash: «Do you know where does he live?» → **Do you know where he lives?**; «Can you tell me where is the station?» → **Can you tell me where the station is?**; «I don't know what is his name.» → **I don't know what his name is.**; «I don't know where did she go.» → **I don't know where she went.**

Ha / yo'q savollarida (Is she at home? Did he call?) savol so'zi yo'q. Bilvosita savolda uning o'rniga **if** yoki **whether** qo'yiladi, keyin yana darak tartib: Is she at home? → Do you know **if she is** at home? Did he call? → I'm not sure **whether he called**. O'zbekchada bu «... -mi yo'qmi», «bor-yo'qligini», «kelgan-kelmaganini» kabi beriladi. **whether** biroz rasmiyroq, ma'nosi bir xil; «whether or not» ham deyiladi.

items.text: Do you know **if** the museum is open on Mondays?
I'm not sure **whether** Tom got my message.

rows: Do you know where Madina is?
Could you tell me what time it is?
Have you any idea how old he is?
I don't know why she's late.
I'm not sure if it's true.
I can't remember where I put it.
I wonder what time it is.

blocks.text: Notanish odamga savol berganda **Could you tell me ...?** yoki **Do you know ...?** bilan boshlangan bilvosita savol to'g'ri savoldan ancha xushmuomalaroq eshitiladi: «Where is the bank?» o'rniga **Excuse me, could you tell me where the bank is?** O'zbekchadagi «Ayta olmaysizmi, ...» kabi.

Eslab qolish: bilvosita savol — «savol ichidagi darak gap». Savol so'zini qoldiring, keyin xuddi oddiy gapdagidek **ega + fe'l** yozing: where **he lives**, what **it costs**, if **she is** ready. do / does / did — yo'q. Savol so'zi yo'q bo'lsa — **if**.

Agar savol so'zi o'zi ega bo'lsa (Who lives here? What happened?), tartib o'zgarmaydi: Do you know **who lives** here? I don't know **what happened**. (→ 45-dars). Kimdir bergan savolni yetkazish (She asked me where I lived) — o'zlashtirma gap, → 50-dars.

items: Bilvosita savol: **Do you know / Can you tell me / I don't know + savol so'zi + ega + fe'l**.
Ichki qismda tartib darak gapdagidek: where **the station is** (where is the station emas).
**do / does / did** yo'qoladi: what he **wants**, when it **started**.
Ha / yo'q savoli: **if / whether** + ega + fe'l — if she **is** at home.
Asosiy gap darak bo'lsa — oxirida nuqta: I don't know where he is**.**

examples.title: **Do you know where** ... **is**?
examples.description: **be** bilan bilvosita savol: Where **is** the post office? → Do you know where **the post office is**? Ega oldin, is / are oxirida.

sentences.text: Do you know where **the post office is**?
sentences.translation: Pochta **qayerdaligini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Aziz, do you know what time **it is**?
sentences.translation: Aziz, soat **necha bo'lganini** bilasanmi?

sentences.text: Excuse me, do you know where **the toilets are**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hojatxona **qayerdaligini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: Does anybody know who **that man is**? He's been standing outside for an hour.
sentences.translation: Anavi odam **kimligini** kimdir biladimi? U bir soatdan beri tashqarida turibdi.

sentences.text: Do you know how old **Madina's grandmother is**?
sentences.translation: Madinaning buvisi **necha yoshdaligini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Have you any idea where **my glasses are**? I can't find them anywhere.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagim **qayerdaligini** bilmaysizmi? Hech qayerdan topolmayapman.

sentences.text: Tom, do you know when **the next train is**?
sentences.translation: Tom, keyingi poyezd **qachonligini** bilasanmi?

sentences.text: Nobody knows how deep **this lake is**.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'l **qanchalik chuqurligini** hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Sorry, do you know what **the Wi-Fi password is**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Wi-Fi paroli **nimaligini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Can you remember where **we were** on this day last year?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili shu kuni **qayerda bo'lganimiz** esingizdami?

examples.title: **Do you know what** he **wants**? — no do / did
examples.description: To'g'ri savoldagi **do / does / did** bilvosita savolda yo'qoladi, fe'l o'z shaklini oladi: What does he want? → ... what he **wants**. Where did she buy it? → ... where she **bought** it.

sentences.text: Do you know what **Bekzod wants** for his birthday?
sentences.translation: Bekzod tug'ilgan kuniga **nima xohlashini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah, do you know when **the film starts**?
sentences.translation: Sara, film **qachon boshlanishini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Does anyone know how much **a ticket to Oxford costs**?
sentences.translation: Oksfordgacha chipta **qancha turishini** kimdir biladimi?

sentences.text: Do you know where **Emma bought** that lovely dress?
sentences.translation: Emma o'sha chiroyli ko'ylakni **qayerdan olganini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina, do you know what time **the bank opens** on Saturdays?
sentences.translation: Madina, shanba kunlari bank **soat nechada ochilishini** bilasanmi?

sentences.text: Excuse me, do you know which bus **goes** to the hospital?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shifoxonaga **qaysi avtobus borishini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: I'd love to know how **they made** this cake. It's amazing!
sentences.translation: Bu tortni **qanday tayyorlashganini** bilishni juda xohlardim. Ajoyib!

sentences.text: Did you hear what **the teacher said** about the homework?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi uy vazifasi haqida **nima deganini** eshitdingizmi?

sentences.text: Tom, have you any idea why **Aziz left** so early?
sentences.translation: Tom, Aziz nega **bunchalik erta ketganini** bilmaysanmi?

sentences.text: Nobody remembers when **the old bridge was built**.
sentences.translation: Eski ko'prik **qachon qurilganini** hech kim eslamaydi.

examples.title: **I don't know where** ... / **I'm not sure what** ...
examples.description: Darak gap ichidagi bilvosita savol: **I don't know / I'm not sure / I can't remember** + savol so'zi + ega + fe'l. Oxirida nuqta, so'roq belgisi emas.

sentences.text: I don't know where **Tom lives**.
sentences.translation: Tom **qayerda yashashini** bilmayman.

sentences.text: I'm not sure what time **the shop closes**.
sentences.translation: Do'kon **soat nechada yopilishini** aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't remember what **your name is**.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ismingiz **nima ekanini** eslay olmayapman.

sentences.text: Bekzod doesn't know how **he will pay** for the new car.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi mashina uchun **qanday to'lashini** bilmaydi.

sentences.text: The police still don't know who **broke** the window.
sentences.translation: Politsiya derazani **kim sindirganini** hali ham bilmaydi.

sentences.text: We aren't sure when **we'll be** back from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxorodan **qachon qaytishimizni** aniq bilmaymiz.

sentences.text: I have no idea why **she's** angry with me.
sentences.translation: Nega menga **jahli chiqqanini** umuman bilmayman.

sentences.text: My grandmother can't remember where **she put** her keys.
sentences.translation: Buvim kalitlarini **qayerga qo'yganini** eslay olmayapti.

sentences.text: It's hard to say how long **the repairs will take**.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirlash **qancha vaqt olishini** aytish qiyin.

sentences.text: Dilnoza wasn't sure which dress **she should wear** to the wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'yga **qaysi ko'ylakni kiyishini** bilmay qoldi.

examples.title: **Could you tell me where** ...? — polite questions
examples.description: Notanish odamdan so'raganda bilvosita savol xushmuomalaroq: Where is the pharmacy? → **Could you tell me where the pharmacy is?** O'zbekchadagi «Ayta olmaysizmi, ...» kabi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, could you tell me where **the nearest pharmacy is**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, eng yaqin dorixona **qayerdaligini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Could you tell me how much **these shoes cost**?
sentences.translation: Bu poyabzal **qancha turishini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Can you tell me what time **the museum closes** today?
sentences.translation: Muzey bugun **soat nechada yopilishini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Sorry to bother you. Could you tell me which platform **the Oxford train leaves** from?
sentences.translation: Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr. Oksford poyezdi **qaysi platformadan jo'nashini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Hello, can you tell me how **I can get** to the city centre?
sentences.translation: Salom, shahar markaziga **qanday borishimni** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Please tell me honestly what **you think** of my essay.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, inshoim haqida **nima deb o'ylashingizni** rostini ayting.

sentences.text: Could you tell me when **Dr Karimova will be** back?
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimova **qachon qaytishini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Can you show me where **I should sign**?
sentences.translation: **Qayerga imzo qo'yishim kerakligini** ko'rsatib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Good morning. I'd like to know how long **the course lasts**.
sentences.translation: Xayrli tong. Kurs **qancha davom etishini** bilmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how far **the castle is** from here?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qal'a bu yerdan **qancha uzoqligini** ayta olasizmi?

examples.title: **if** / **whether**: yes / no questions
examples.description: Savol so'zi bo'lmasa (Is she ...? Did I ...?) — **if** yoki **whether** + ega + fe'l: Do you know **if** she's at home? O'zbekchada: «... -mi yo'qmi», «bor-yo'qligini».

sentences.text: Do you know **if Madina is** at home?
sentences.translation: Madina uyda**mi-yo'qmi** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: I'm not sure **if I locked** the door.
sentences.translation: Eshikni **qulflaganimga** ishonchim komil emas.

sentences.text: Could you check **whether there are** any seats left on the train?
sentences.translation: Poyezdda bo'sh joy **bor-yo'qligini** tekshirib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: I wonder **if it will** rain tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir **yog'armikin**.

sentences.text: Ask Sarah **whether she wants** tea or coffee.
sentences.translation: Saradan choy **xohlaydimi** yoki qahva — so'rang.

sentences.text: Nobody knows **if the match will** go ahead in this weather.
sentences.translation: Bunday havoda o'yin **bo'ladimi-yo'qmi**, hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Can you find out **if the hotel has** a swimming pool?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada basseyn **bor-yo'qligini** bilib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: I can't remember **whether I've** paid the electricity bill.
sentences.translation: Elektr uchun **to'laganim-to'lamaganim** esimda yo'q.

sentences.text: Aziz doesn't know **if his parents will** come to London for his graduation.
sentences.translation: Ota-onasi bitiruvi uchun Londonga **kelishadimi-yo'qmi**, Aziz bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Let me see **if the manager is** free to talk to you.
sentences.translation: Menejer siz bilan gaplashishga **bo'shmi-yo'qmi**, bilib ko'ray.

examples.title: **I wonder** ..., **Any idea** ...?, **Guess** ...!
examples.description: Boshqa iboralar: **I wonder** («... ekan-a», «... -ikin»), **Have you got any idea**, **Tell me**, **I'd like to know**, **Guess**, **It doesn't matter**. Ichidagi tartib doim darak gapdagidek.

sentences.text: I wonder what **Madina is doing** now.
sentences.translation: Madina hozir **nima qilayotgan ekan**.

sentences.text: I wonder why **the bus is** so late today.
sentences.translation: Avtobus bugun nega **bunchalik kechikayotgan ekan**.

sentences.text: Have you got any idea how **this machine works**?
sentences.translation: Bu mashina **qanday ishlashini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: Tell me what **happened** at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda **nima bo'lganini** aytib bering.

sentences.text: My brother can't remember when **he last saw** a doctor.
sentences.translation: Akam shifokorga oxirgi marta **qachon borganini** eslay olmaydi.

sentences.text: Emma would like to know how **you make** Uzbek bread.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zbek nonini **qanday yopishingizni** bilmoqchi.

sentences.text: We're trying to decide where **we should go** for our holiday.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilga **qayerga borishimizni** hal qilishga harakat qilyapmiz.

sentences.text: Guess who **I met** in the supermarket this morning!
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab supermarketda **kimni uchratganimni** toping-chi!

sentences.text: It doesn't matter what **other people think**.
sentences.translation: Boshqalar **nima deb o'ylashi** muhim emas.

sentences.text: Bekzod is worried. He doesn't understand why **his boss hasn't replied** to his email.
sentences.translation: Bekzod xavotirda. Rahbari nega xatiga **javob bermaganini** tushunmayapti.

examples.title: Direct → indirect: **Where is he?** → **where he is**
examples.description: Bitta gapda ikki savol: to'g'ri savol (yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin) va bilvosita savol (ega fe'ldan oldin, do / did siz). Farqni solishtiring.

sentences.text: Where's Aziz? I don't know where **he is**.
sentences.translation: Aziz qani? Uning **qayerdaligini** bilmayman.

sentences.text: What time does the concert start? I can't remember what time **it starts**.
sentences.translation: Konsert soat nechada boshlanadi? **Soat nechada boshlanishini** eslay olmayapman.

sentences.text: Why was Emma crying? Nobody knows why **she was** crying.
sentences.translation: Emma nega yig'layotgan edi? Uning **nega yig'layotganini** hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: How old is your teacher? — I'm not sure how old **she is**.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchingiz necha yoshda? — **Necha yoshdaligini** aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: Where did Dilnoza go? Her mother wants to know where **she went**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza qayerga ketdi? Onasi uning **qayerga ketganini** bilmoqchi.

sentences.text: Is the shop open? Let's call and ask if **it's** open.
sentences.translation: Do'kon ochiqmi? Qo'ng'iroq qilib, **ochiq-yopiqligini** so'raylik.

sentences.text: Has the parcel arrived? Could you check whether **it has** arrived?
sentences.translation: Posilka keldimi? **Kelgan-kelmaganini** tekshirib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: What does this word mean? Look it up — I don't know what **it means**.
sentences.translation: Bu so'z nimani anglatadi? Lug'atdan qarang — **nimani anglatishini** bilmayman.

sentences.text: Who's that woman? I've got no idea who **she is**.
sentences.translation: Anavi ayol kim? Uning **kimligini** umuman bilmayman.

sentences.text: Will Bekzod come to the party? I wonder if **he'll** come.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ziyofatga keladimi? **Kelarmikin**.

examples.title: Dialogue: lost in Oxford
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Oksfordda adashib qolgan sayyoh yo'l so'raydi — **could you tell me where**, **I'm not sure if**, **I wonder how**.

sentences.text: — Excuse me, could you tell me where **the bus station is**?
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, avtovokzal **qayerdaligini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: — Sorry, I'm not from here. I don't know where **anything is**!
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, men bu yerlik emasman. Hech narsaning **qayerdaligini** bilmayman!

sentences.text: — Oh, OK. Have you any idea if **there's** a tourist office near here?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Yaqin atrofda turistlar uchun ma'lumot markazi **bor-yo'qligini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: — I think there's one in the main square, but I'm not sure exactly where **it is**.
sentences.translation: — Menimcha, bittasi asosiy maydonda, lekin aniq **qayerdaligini** bilmayman.

sentences.text: — Thanks anyway. Hello, sir! Can you tell me how **I get** to the bus station?
sentences.translation: — Baribir rahmat. Assalomu alaykum! Avtovokzalga **qanday borishimni** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: — Of course. I'll show you where **it is** on your map.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Xaritangizda uning **qayerdaligini** ko'rsatib qo'yaman.

sentences.text: — Thank you! And have you any idea what time **the last bus to London leaves**?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Londonga oxirgi avtobus **soat nechada jo'nashini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: — I'm not sure if **it's** at ten or eleven. You'd better check at the station.
sentences.translation: — O'nda**mi** yoki o'n birda**mi**, aniq bilmayman. Bekatda so'raganingiz ma'qul.

sentences.text: — I will. I wonder how many **tourists get** lost here every day!
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Bu yerda har kuni **qancha turist adashar ekan**!

sentences.text: — Quite a lot! Even I sometimes forget where **all the colleges are**.
sentences.translation: — Ancha ko'p! Hatto men ham ba'zan barcha kollejlar **qayerdaligini** unutib qo'yaman.
